title: Understanding the organization and its context
paraphrase: The organisation determines external and internal issues relevant to its purpose that affect its ability to achieve the intended outcomes of the information security management system.

title: Understanding the needs and expectations of interested parties
paraphrase: The organisation determines interested parties relevant to the ISMS and their relevant requirements including legal and regulatory requirements.

title: Determining the scope of the information security management system
paraphrase: The boundaries and applicability of the ISMS are determined and documented.

title: Information security management system
paraphrase: The organisation establishes implements maintains and continually improves an ISMS including the processes needed and their interactions.

title: Leadership and commitment
paraphrase: Top management demonstrates leadership and commitment with respect to the information security management system.

title: Policy
paraphrase: Top management establishes an information security policy appropriate to the purpose of the organisation that includes objectives and a commitment to continual improvement.

title: Organizational roles, responsibilities and authorities
paraphrase: Top management ensures that responsibilities and authorities for roles relevant to information security are assigned and communicated.

title: Actions to address risks and opportunities - general
paraphrase: When planning the ISMS the organisation considers the issues and requirements identified and determines the risks and opportunities that need to be addressed.

title: Information security risk assessment
paraphrase: The organisation defines and applies an information security risk assessment process that establishes risk criteria identifies analyses and evaluates risks and produces consistent valid and comparable results.

title: Information security risk treatment
paraphrase: The organisation defines and applies a risk treatment process to select treatment options determine necessary controls and produce a Statement of Applicability.

title: Information security objectives and planning to achieve them
paraphrase: Information security objectives are established at relevant functions and levels consistent with the policy measurable monitored and updated as appropriate.

title: Planning of changes
paraphrase: Changes to the information security management system are carried out in a planned manner.

title: Resources
paraphrase: The organisation determines and provides the resources needed for the information security management system.

title: Competence
paraphrase: The organisation determines the necessary competence of persons affecting information security performance and ensures they are competent on the basis of education training or experience.

title: Awareness
paraphrase: Persons doing work under the organisation's control are aware of the information security policy their contribution to the ISMS and the implications of not conforming.

title: Communication
paraphrase: The organisation determines the internal and external communications relevant to the ISMS including what when with whom and how to communicate.

title: Documented information - general
paraphrase: The ISMS includes documented information required by the standard and determined by the organisation as necessary for effectiveness.

title: Creating and updating documented information
paraphrase: Documented information is appropriately identified described formatted reviewed and approved.

title: Control of documented information
paraphrase: Documented information is available where needed and adequately protected including control of distribution access retrieval storage retention and disposition.

title: Operational planning and control
paraphrase: The organisation plans implements and controls the processes needed to meet requirements and to implement the actions determined in planning.

title: Information security risk assessment
paraphrase: The organisation performs information security risk assessments at planned intervals and when significant changes are proposed or occur and retains documented information on the results.

title: Information security risk treatment
paraphrase: The organisation implements the information security risk treatment plan and retains documented information of the results.

title: Monitoring, measurement, analysis and evaluation
paraphrase: The organisation determines what needs to be monitored and measured the methods to be used and when monitoring measuring analysis and evaluation are performed.

title: Internal audit - general
paraphrase: The organisation conducts internal audits at planned intervals to determine whether the ISMS conforms to requirements and is effectively implemented and maintained.

title: Internal audit programme
paraphrase: An audit programme is planned established implemented and maintained including frequency methods responsibilities and reporting.

title: Management review - general
paraphrase: Top management reviews the ISMS at planned intervals to ensure its continuing suitability adequacy and effectiveness.

title: Management review inputs
paraphrase: The management review considers the status of prior actions changes in issues and requirements information security performance audit results and opportunities for improvement.

title: Management review results
paraphrase: The results of the management review include decisions related to continual improvement opportunities and any need for changes to the ISMS.

title: Continual improvement
paraphrase: The organisation continually improves the suitability adequacy and effectiveness of the information security management system.

title: Nonconformity and corrective action
paraphrase: When a nonconformity occurs the organisation reacts to it evaluates the need for action to eliminate its causes implements action and reviews effectiveness.

title: Policies for information security
paraphrase: Information security policy and topic-specific policies are defined approved by management published and reviewed at planned intervals.

title: Information security roles and responsibilities
paraphrase: Security roles and responsibilities are defined and allocated according to organisational needs.

title: Segregation of duties
paraphrase: Conflicting duties and areas of responsibility are segregated to reduce opportunity for unauthorised or unintentional modification or misuse.

title: Management responsibilities
paraphrase: Management requires all personnel to apply information security in accordance with established policies and procedures.

title: Contact with authorities
paraphrase: Appropriate contacts with relevant authorities are established and maintained.

title: Contact with special interest groups
paraphrase: Contacts with special interest groups security forums and professional associations are maintained.

title: Threat intelligence
paraphrase: Information relating to information security threats is collected and analysed to produce threat intelligence.

title: Information security in project management
paraphrase: Information security is integrated into project management regardless of project type.

title: Inventory of information and other associated assets
paraphrase: An inventory of information and other associated assets including owners is developed and maintained.

title: Acceptable use of information and other associated assets
paraphrase: Rules for acceptable use and procedures for handling information and associated assets are identified documented and implemented.

title: Return of assets
paraphrase: Personnel and interested parties return organisational assets on change or termination of employment contract or agreement.

title: Classification of information
paraphrase: Information is classified according to confidentiality integrity availability and relevant interested-party requirements.

title: Labelling of information
paraphrase: Procedures for labelling information are developed and implemented in accordance with the classification scheme.

title: Information transfer
paraphrase: Transfer rules procedures and agreements are in place for all types of transfer facilities.

title: Access control
paraphrase: Rules to control physical and logical access to information and associated assets are established and implemented based on business and security requirements.

title: Identity management
paraphrase: The full life cycle of identities is managed.

title: Authentication information
paraphrase: Allocation and management of authentication information is controlled including advising personnel on appropriate handling.

title: Access rights
paraphrase: Access rights to information and associated assets are provisioned reviewed modified and removed in accordance with the access control policy.

title: Information security in supplier relationships
paraphrase: Processes and procedures manage the security risks associated with use of supplier products and services.

title: Addressing information security within supplier agreements
paraphrase: Relevant security requirements are established and agreed with each supplier based on the type of relationship.

title: Managing information security in the ICT supply chain
paraphrase: Processes and procedures manage security risks associated with the ICT product and service supply chain.

title: Monitoring review and change management of supplier services
paraphrase: Changes to supplier services are regularly monitored reviewed evaluated and managed.

title: Information security for use of cloud services
paraphrase: Processes for acquisition use management and exit from cloud services are established in accordance with security requirements.

title: Information security incident management planning and preparation
paraphrase: Incident management is planned and prepared by defining establishing and communicating processes roles and responsibilities.

title: Assessment and decision on information security events
paraphrase: Security events are assessed and a decision is taken on whether they are classified as incidents.

title: Response to information security incidents
paraphrase: Security incidents are responded to in accordance with documented procedures.

title: Learning from information security incidents
paraphrase: Knowledge gained from incidents is used to strengthen and improve controls.

title: Collection of evidence
paraphrase: Procedures for identification collection acquisition and preservation of evidence related to security events are established and implemented.

title: Information security during disruption
paraphrase: Plans are in place to maintain information security at an appropriate level during disruption.

title: ICT readiness for business continuity
paraphrase: ICT readiness is planned implemented maintained and tested based on business continuity objectives and ICT continuity requirements.

title: Legal statutory regulatory and contractual requirements
paraphrase: Legal statutory regulatory and contractual requirements relevant to information security and the approach to meet them are identified documented and kept up to date.

title: Intellectual property rights
paraphrase: Appropriate procedures protect intellectual property rights.

title: Protection of records
paraphrase: Records are protected from loss destruction falsification unauthorised access and unauthorised release.

title: Privacy and protection of PII
paraphrase: Requirements for the preservation of privacy and protection of personally identifiable information are identified and met according to applicable law and contractual requirements.

title: Independent review of information security
paraphrase: The approach to managing information security and its implementation are reviewed independently at planned intervals or on significant change.

title: Compliance with policies rules and standards for information security
paraphrase: Compliance with the organisation's information security policy topic-specific policies rules and standards is regularly reviewed.

title: Documented operating procedures
paraphrase: Operating procedures for information processing facilities are documented and made available to personnel who need them.

title: Screening
paraphrase: Background verification checks on candidates are carried out prior to joining and on an ongoing basis proportionate to business requirements and perceived risks.

title: Terms and conditions of employment
paraphrase: Employment contractual agreements state personnel and organisational responsibilities for information security.

title: Information security awareness education and training
paraphrase: Personnel and relevant interested parties receive appropriate awareness education and training and regular updates on policies and procedures relevant to their role.

title: Disciplinary process
paraphrase: A formalised and communicated disciplinary process is in place to take action against personnel and other interested parties who have committed a security policy violation.

title: Responsibilities after termination or change of employment
paraphrase: Information security responsibilities that remain valid after termination or change of employment are defined enforced and communicated.

title: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements
paraphrase: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements reflecting the organisation's needs are identified documented regularly reviewed and signed.

title: Remote working
paraphrase: Security measures are implemented when personnel work remotely to protect information accessed processed or stored outside the organisation's premises.

title: Information security event reporting
paraphrase: A mechanism is provided for personnel to report observed or suspected security events through appropriate channels in a timely manner.

title: Physical security perimeters
paraphrase: Security perimeters are defined and used to protect areas containing information and other associated assets.

title: Physical entry
paraphrase: Secure areas are protected by appropriate entry controls and access points.

title: Securing offices rooms and facilities
paraphrase: Physical security for offices rooms and facilities is designed and implemented.

title: Physical security monitoring
paraphrase: Premises are continuously monitored for unauthorised physical access.

title: Protecting against physical and environmental threats
paraphrase: Protection against physical and environmental threats such as natural disasters and other intentional or unintentional threats is designed and implemented.

title: Working in secure areas
paraphrase: Security measures for working in secure areas are designed and implemented.

title: Clear desk and clear screen
paraphrase: Clear desk rules for papers and removable storage media and clear screen rules for information processing facilities are defined and enforced.

title: Equipment siting and protection
paraphrase: Equipment is sited securely and protected.

title: Security of assets off-premises
paraphrase: Off-site assets are protected.

title: Storage media
paraphrase: Storage media are managed through their life cycle of acquisition use transportation and disposal in accordance with the classification scheme and handling requirements.

title: Supporting utilities
paraphrase: Information processing facilities are protected from power failures and other disruptions caused by failures in supporting utilities.

title: Cabling security
paraphrase: Cables carrying power data or supporting information services are protected from interception interference or damage.

title: Equipment maintenance
paraphrase: Equipment is maintained correctly to ensure availability integrity and confidentiality of information.

title: Secure disposal or re-use of equipment
paraphrase: Items of equipment containing storage media are verified to ensure sensitive data and licensed software are removed or securely overwritten prior to disposal or re-use.

title: User endpoint devices
paraphrase: Information stored on processed by or accessible via user endpoint devices is protected.

title: Privileged access rights
paraphrase: The allocation and use of privileged access rights is restricted and managed.

title: Information access restriction
paraphrase: Access to information and other associated assets is restricted in accordance with the established access control policy.

title: Access to source code
paraphrase: Read and write access to source code development tools and software libraries is appropriately managed.

title: Secure authentication
paraphrase: Secure authentication technologies and procedures are implemented based on information access restrictions and the access control policy.

title: Capacity management
paraphrase: The use of resources is monitored and adjusted in line with current and expected capacity requirements.

title: Protection against malware
paraphrase: Protection against malware is implemented and supported by appropriate user awareness.

title: Management of technical vulnerabilities
paraphrase: Information about technical vulnerabilities of information systems in use is obtained exposure to such vulnerabilities is evaluated and appropriate measures are taken.

title: Configuration management
paraphrase: Configurations including security configurations of hardware software services and networks are established documented implemented monitored and reviewed.

title: Information deletion
paraphrase: Information stored in information systems devices or other storage media is deleted when no longer required.

title: Data masking
paraphrase: Data masking is used in accordance with the access control policy and other related policies and business requirements taking applicable legislation into consideration.

title: Data leakage prevention
paraphrase: Data leakage prevention measures are applied to systems networks and other devices that process store or transmit sensitive information.

title: Information backup
paraphrase: Backup copies of information software and systems are maintained and regularly tested in accordance with the agreed backup policy.

title: Redundancy of information processing facilities
paraphrase: Information processing facilities are implemented with redundancy sufficient to meet availability requirements.

title: Logging
paraphrase: Logs that record activities exceptions faults and other relevant events are produced stored protected and analysed.

title: Monitoring activities
paraphrase: Networks systems and applications are monitored for anomalous behaviour and appropriate actions are taken to evaluate potential security incidents.

title: Clock synchronization
paraphrase: The clocks of information processing systems are synchronised to approved time sources.

title: Use of privileged utility programs
paraphrase: The use of utility programs capable of overriding system and application controls is restricted and tightly controlled.

title: Installation of software on operational systems
paraphrase: Procedures and measures are implemented to securely manage software installation on operational systems.

title: Networks security
paraphrase: Networks and network devices are secured managed and controlled to protect information in systems and applications.

title: Security of network services
paraphrase: Security mechanisms service levels and service requirements of network services are identified implemented and monitored.

title: Segregation of networks
paraphrase: Groups of information services users and information systems are segregated in the organisation's networks.

title: Web filtering
paraphrase: Access to external websites is managed to reduce exposure to malicious content.

title: Use of cryptography
paraphrase: Rules for the effective use of cryptography including cryptographic key management are defined and implemented.

title: Secure development life cycle
paraphrase: Rules for the secure development of software and systems are established and applied.

title: Application security requirements
paraphrase: Information security requirements are identified specified and approved when developing or acquiring applications.

title: Secure system architecture and engineering principles
paraphrase: Principles for engineering secure systems are established documented maintained and applied to information system development activities.

title: Secure coding
paraphrase: Secure coding principles are applied to software development.

title: Security testing in development and acceptance
paraphrase: Security testing processes are defined and implemented in the development life cycle.

title: Outsourced development
paraphrase: The organisation directs monitors and reviews the activities related to outsourced system development.

title: Separation of development test and production environments
paraphrase: Development testing and production environments are separated and secured.

title: Change management
paraphrase: Changes to information processing facilities and information systems are subject to change management procedures.

title: Test information
paraphrase: Test information is appropriately selected protected and managed.

title: Protection of information systems during audit testing
paraphrase: Audit tests and other assurance activities involving assessment of operational systems are planned and agreed between the tester and appropriate management.
